propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was delivery lead for the migration of 38,000 private-client accounts and held delegated authority under the programme charter to approve scope changes of up to ten person-days.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the role and the limit, and the charter extract records both.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate made the go decision for the March 2024 final migration weekend against the charter's cutover criteria, recorded in the decision log and countersigned by the executive sponsor.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the decision and the decision-log pages show the sign-off.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate chaired the weekly milestone review with the platform vendor and the data-conversion contractor against the contract schedule.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the review and what was recorded.

expectedGap: The candidate wrote two sections of the client-communication plan; the plan itself was prepared and owned by the marketing team.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the documented delivery-lead role, the ten person-day approval limit and the countersigned cutover decision; do not extend the candidate's part in client communications beyond the two sections written.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask what part the candidate played in deciding the timing and content of client communications beyond the two plan sections.
